basic_details.job_title: Chief Medical and Health Officer, South Bastar Dantewada Community Health Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Office of the Chief Medical and Health Officer, District South Bastar Dantewada (Chhattisgarh) (Chief Medical and Health Officer, South Bastar Dantewada) has invited applications for 6 posts of Community Health Officer under Advt No. 6610/मु.चि.अ./एन.एच.एम/भर्ती/2026. The online application is open from 2 November 2026 to 16 November 2026.

application_fee.sc_fee: Rs. 100.00 (posts with honorarium up to Rs. 25000); Rs. 200.00 (above Rs. 25000)
application_fee.obc_fee: Rs. 200.00 (posts with honorarium up to Rs. 25000); Rs. 300.00 (above Rs. 25000)
application_fee.general_fee: Rs. 300.00 (posts with honorarium up to Rs. 25000); Rs. 400.00 (above Rs. 25000)
application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand draft made in the name of District Health Society Dantewada.

age_limit.age_details: Minimum 18 years; maximum 70 years for medical posts and 64 years for managerial posts (as on 1 January 2026)

qualification.education_qualification: B.Sc. Nursing certificate in Community Health Integrated Course OR Post Basic Nursing Certificate in Community Health Integrated Course, and live registration in Chhattisgarh Nursing Registration Council
qualification.details: Qualification: B.Sc. Nursing certificate in Community Health Integrated Course OR Post Basic Nursing Certificate in Community Health Integrated Course; Live Registration in Chhattisgarh Nursing Registration Council Experience: Not essential; experience in related field gives 2 marks per year up to 10 marks (3 marks per year up to 15 marks for NHM employees) Age limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum 70 years for medical posts and 64 years for managerial posts (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: Government rules Relaxation as granted by the Government from time to time | Other conditions: | Must be a local resident of Chhattisgarh State Original local residence certificate of the concerned district issued by competent authority required Qualification certificates must be held on or before the last day of application Grading-system candidates must state percentage and attach the conversion chart from the institution head Employees of government or semi-government bodies need an NOC not older than 6 months

exam_pattern.details: Candidate must obtain 30 percent of the total marks fixed for the skill test / interview, else ineligible

how_to_apply: Apply only through the online link given in the notice on the district website www.dantewada.gov.in.
Apply between 02.11.2026 and 16.11.2026 up to 5.30 PM office time.
Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates and documents.
Submit the fee by demand draft made in the name of District Health Society Dantewada.
Applications by speed post, registered post, ordinary post or any other mode will not be accepted.
important_instructions: New documents at the claim-objection stage will not be accepted; only clerical errors corrected No TA or other allowance for attending Results and all information on the CMHO office notice board and www.dantewada.gov.in only Vacancies may be reduced, increased, changed or cancelled Recruitment subject to final order of the Supreme Court in SLP(C) No. 19668/2022

content_sections.text: Qualification: B.Sc. Nursing certificate in Community Health Integrated Course OR Post Basic Nursing Certificate in Community Health Integrated Course; Live Registration in Chhattisgarh Nursing Registration Council Experience: Not essential; experience in related field gives 2 marks per year up to 10 marks (3 marks per year up to 15 marks for NHM employees) Age limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum 70 years for medical posts and 64 years for managerial posts (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: Government rules Relaxation as granted by the Government from time to time Other conditions: Must be a local resident of Chhattisgarh State Original local residence certificate of the concerned district issued by competent authority required Qualification certificates must be held on or before the last day of application Grading-system candidates must state percentage and attach the conversion chart from the institution head Employees of government or semi-government bodies need an NOC not older than 6 months

content_sections.heading: How Will Chief Medical and Health Officer, South Bastar Dantewada Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit list for skill test on educational qualification + experience marks Written / skill / interview test (20 marks) Final selection list on qualification + experience + skill test marks Document verification Educational qualification: 65 percent marks Experience: up to 10 marks (up to 15 marks for NHM employees) Written / skill / interview test: 20 marks; minimum 30 percent of its total marks required For 1 to 10 posts, 10 times the advertised vacancies are called for document verification / test / interview Tie broken by older date of birth, then first initial in English alphabet

content_sections.heading: Chief Medical and Health Officer, South Bastar Dantewada Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Candidate must obtain 30 percent of the total marks fixed for the skill test / interview, else ineligible

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Class 10 marksheet or birth certificate as proof of date of birth Relevant diploma / degree Live registration certificate of the relevant Chhattisgarh State council (if applicable) Permanent caste certificate from competent authority (if applicable) Local residence certificate, experience certificate with appointment order, NOC if employed Recent passport-size photograph attested by a gazetted officer or self

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Chief Medical and Health Officer, South Bastar Dantewada Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply only through the online link given in the notice on the district website www.dantewada.gov.in. Apply between 02.11.2026 and 16.11.2026 up to 5.30 PM office time. Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates and documents. Submit the fee by demand draft made in the name of District Health Society Dantewada. Applications by speed post, registered post, ordinary post or any other mode will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: New documents at the claim-objection stage will not be accepted; only clerical errors corrected No TA or other allowance for attending Results and all information on the CMHO office notice board and www.dantewada.gov.in only Vacancies may be reduced, increased, changed or cancelled Recruitment subject to final order of the Supreme Court in SLP(C) No. 19668/2022

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Chief Medical and Health Officer, South Bastar Dantewada Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 16 November 2026. Applications opened on 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Chief Medical and Health Officer, South Bastar Dantewada Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies for Community Health Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Chief Medical and Health Officer, South Bastar Dantewada Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PwD / SC / ST / Women: Rs. 100.00 (posts with honorarium up to Rs. 25000); Rs. 200.00 (above Rs. 25000). OBC: Rs. 200.00 (posts with honorarium up to Rs. 25000); Rs. 300.00 (above Rs. 25000). Unreserved: Rs. 300.00 (posts with honorarium up to Rs. 25000); Rs. 400.00 (above Rs. 25000).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years; maximum 70 years for medical posts and 64 years for managerial posts (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: Government rules Relaxation as granted by the Government from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 16500 consolidated pay.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Sc. Nursing certificate in Community Health Integrated Course OR Post Basic Nursing Certificate in Community Health Integrated Course, and live registration in Chhattisgarh Nursing Registration Council.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a local resident of Chhattisgarh State. Original local residence certificate of the concerned district issued by competent authority required. Qualification certificates must be held on or before the last day of application. Grading-system candidates must state percentage and attach the conversion chart from the institution head.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates whose service was terminated by NHM or any government department for indiscipline, financial irregularity or misconduct. Applicants found involved in criminal tendency, misconduct or unethical acts. Applicants using recommendation or political pressure.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit list for skill test on educational qualification + experience marks. Written / skill / interview test (20 marks). Final selection list on qualification + experience + skill test marks. Document verification.
